# Table

Dense data table for hosts, containers, ports, logs: tabular numbers, optional monospace columns, horizontal scroll on small screens.

`KenosUI.Table` · Homelab

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Table>…</KenosUI.Table>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Table">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Dense data table, tabular numbers, optional mono columns.

## Props (TableProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `responsive` | `"cards" \| "scroll"` | "cards" (default): rows become cards when the container is < 34rem. "scroll": always a table, scrolls sideways. |
| `selectable` | `boolean` | Checkbox column with select-all. Needs `rowKey`. |
| `selected` | `Array<string \| number>` |  |
| `defaultSelected` | `Array<string \| number>` |  |
| `onSelectedChange` | `(keys: Array<string \| number>) => void` |  |
| `sort` | `{ key: string; dir: "asc" \| "desc" } \| null` | Current sort (controlled) — columns need `sortable: true`. Click cycles asc → desc → off. |
| `defaultSort` | `{ key: string; dir: "asc" \| "desc" } \| null` |  |
| `onSortChange` | `(sort: { key: string; dir: "asc" \| "desc" } \| null) => void` |  |
| `manualSort` | `boolean` | Don't sort locally (server-side sorting); only report `onSortChange`. |
| `rowActions` | `(row: Row) => React.ReactNode` | Last column, right-aligned: buttons / a Menu per row. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Shows skeleton rows. |
| `emptyText` | `React.ReactNode` | Text when `rows` is empty. Default "Keine Einträge". |
| `columns` | `TableColumn<Row>[]` |  |
| `rows` | `Row[]` |  |
| `rowKey` | `string` |  |
| `caption` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | Cell padding 6/8 · 12 · 12/16px. Default "sm" (dense). |
| `variant` | `"line" \| "outline"` | Default "line". |
| `striped` | `boolean` |  |
| `interactive` | `boolean` | Row hover. |
| `stickyHeader` | `boolean` |  |
| `onRowClick` | `(row: Row) => void` |  |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | Raw <thead>/<tbody> instead of columns + rows. |

_Also accepts: Omit<React.TableHTMLAttributes<HTMLTableElement>, "children">._
